title: 先進プログラミング
subtitle: Advanced Programming
educationalGoal:
This course is a specialized core class to achieve the specialized core “Information design basic ability” goal of the Department of Management Information.
Students will learn Python, a general-purpose programming language so that they can create simple tools for data analysis.
advice:
This course deals with data representation and programming basics in AI applications basics.
Students will learn the basics and application of Python by completing several programming exercises.
By writing programs, students will produce a tool that will perform data analysis and then use the tool on open data.
Simply running the program in class is not sufficient; students will need to actually run the program on their own, especially as a means of review.
requiredKnowledge:
Students should have a knowledge of general corporate management and information technology by taking other classes.
It is assumed that students will have an understanding of Web design, IT system basics, database management, programming basics, and applied programming; these topics should be reviewed as necessary.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the basic syntax of Python and do simple programming.
Be able to calculate sequences using Python.
Be able to create a simple graph using Python.
Be able to do simple data analysis using Python.
Be able to explain machine learning using Python.
